issues.description: The problem statement instructs students to create a final Stock stock and to initialize it in the SealSaloon constructor (instance initialization), but later requires that the stock attribute must be static (shared across all instances). Initializing a static final field in an instance constructor is not possible and thus the instructions conflict, which can confuse students about how to declare and initialize the stock field.
issues.suggestedFix: Clarify the intended declaration and initialization of the stock attribute. Either (A) require a static (or static final) stock and instruct students to initialize it at the point of declaration (or in a static initializer), or (B) require an instance-level final stock and remove the requirement that stock be static. Update the problem text to remove the contradictory instruction to initialize the stock in the instance constructor if stock must be static.
